integrity: An explicit positive-semidefinite dual, an exact eigenvalue calculation, and an equality-rigidity argument prove the claimed formula and uniqueness; finite checker cases are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: One pendant vertex attached to a clique, unit costs on distinguished spokes and pendant edge, shared positive price on other clique edges, and an unnormalized continuous-time weighted Laplacian. Equivalence to an unindexed prior specialization cannot be ruled out.
title: A sharp core-edge price threshold for fastest diffusion on a pendant clique
